mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a clear 70 degrees at Verona Community Park under a Waning Gibbous moon. If you are up early, keep an eye on the sky at 4:14 AM to see the International Space Station traveling from the Northwest over Verona High School toward the Northeast near Home Depot, staying low near the horizon.

In city news, Mayor Diaz has proclaimed September 2026 as Hunger Action Month to unite our community against food insecurity, and please be aware that flagging on Highway M for utility work continues through tomorrow with traffic delays expected.

There is plenty to do this weekend! Today, we have the Verona Area Kids Triathlon, live music at Bailey's Run, Girls Try Hockey at the arena, and music at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, yoga is available tomorrow, and you can catch trivia at various locations throughout the week.
Regarding the weekly police report, on August 17, officers successfully located and arrested a 21-year-old man in the 500 block of Cross Country Road for a probation violation.
Today's delicious flavor is Crazy for Cookie Dough. The store is currently closed, but it will open today at 10:00 AM so you can grab your scoop.
